name: FlowForge
notes:
### New
- Groq: very fast AI models and Whisper speech-to-text (add your Groq key in AI agents → AI providers)
- Search boxes fixed (workflows and nodes)
- The Windows app now updates itself: it downloads new versions from your website and installs them while your PC is idle and no call is on

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly

downloads.label: Android app (.apk)
downloads.requirements: Android 7 or newer - allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser

downloads.label: iPhone app (.ipa)
downloads.requirements: iOS 15 or newer - unsigned: install with AltStore or Sideloadly using your Apple ID
